==Usage==
<code><nowiki>{{Stub_box| stub-template-1 | stub-template-2 | ... }}</nowiki></code>

This template supports up to 9 positional (unnamed) parameters: a list of [[:Category:Stub templates|Stub templates]] to surround.

==Examples==
<code><nowiki>{{Stub_box|Chiss-stub|Military-stub|Planet-stub}}</nowiki></code>

results in

{{Stub_box|Chiss-stub|Military-stub|Planet-stub}}
and

<code><nowiki>{{Stub_box| Website-stub | Substance-stub | Weapon-stub | Tech-stub }}</nowiki></code>

results in

{{Stub_box| Website-stub | Substance-stub | Weapon-stub | Tech-stub }}

==Categorization==
None: the template passes on the stub categories applied by included stub templates.
